corrected_2026_10_12.summary: TWO BUGS FIXED. The headline reading ('all 8 variants are worse, so the valence budget is a local optimum') was an artefact of a wrong denominator plus a broken loop. Under the correct denominators the picture is a TRADE-OFF, not a local optimum.

bug_1_wrong_denominator.what: single_fragment_ratio divided single by the number of clouds ATTEMPTED. The trainer's metric of the same name (train_cfm_yuelbond_wasserstein.py:4667) divides by molecules that PASSED the chemistry check.
bug_1_wrong_denominator.evidence: same checkpoint (cfm_objective_terms seed0 epoch 5): this script 0.1406 vs the trainer's own ODE path 0.73/0.90/0.88.
bug_1_wrong_denominator.fix: both are now reported; single_fragment_ratio_of_decoded matches the trainer's convention.

bug_2_loop_ran_one_variant.what: while adding try/finally around the variant loop (for global-state restore, itself a real fix), the loop body was left at the old indent level, so only `no_budget` -- the LAST variant -- was measured. Exit code was 0.
bug_2_loop_ran_one_variant.how_caught: grep -c 'single_frag=' returned 1 instead of 8. Verified structurally with ast: the for-loop body went from 1 statement to 15.
bug_2_loop_ran_one_variant.note: third instance this session of a script failing SILENTLY with a clean exit code (CUDA invalid device ordinal; ModuleNotFoundError; this).

bug_3_global_state_not_restored_on_excep.what: _CLASS_VALENCE_COST and _COVALENT_VALENCE are module globals the decoder reads live (cfm_decoder_yuelbond.py:485, :601). The restore block sat OUTSIDE the loop, so an exception left them mutated for the rest of the process -- and no_budget, being last, sets every cost to 0.

THE_REVISED_FINDING.headline_now: as_shipped is not a 'local optimum' in the sense the earlier record claimed. It is one point on a measured trade-off between CONNECTIVITY and DECODE SUCCESS.
THE_REVISED_FINDING.no_budget: connectivity of_decoded = 1.000 and n_frags_mean = 1.000 -- every molecule it decodes IS a single connected fragment. Its weakness is decode_ratio 0.125 vs as_shipped 0.2031, not connectivity. The old table read that decode failure as a connectivity loss.
THE_REVISED_FINDING.reserve_monotone: tightening the reserve collapses connectivity monotonically: of_decoded 0.692 -> 0.200 -> 0.000 and n_frags_mean 1.46 -> 3.00 -> 8.50. That IS a real, correctly-measured relationship.
THE_REVISED_FINDING.reserve_0.5_is_a_no_op: reserve_0.5 is byte-identical to as_shipped on all three columns, because the reserve is applied via int(round(reserve)) and 0.5 rounds to 0. The variant does nothing.

STILL_TRUE_AND_UNCHANGED.the_mechanism_is_load_bearing: no_budget does decode fewer molecules (0.125 vs 0.2031), so the budget does buy sanitisation.
STILL_TRUE_AND_UNCHANGED.this_is_still_the_reconstruction_path: The whole table decodes REAL tmQM geometry, not ODE-from-noise. Bond EXISTENCE F1 on this checkpoint family is 0.9962, i.e. the task is near-solved and differences between variants are compressed. The honest-negative in PAPER_SCOPE about the valence budget being a design argument rather than a performance result SURVIVES -- and is now better supported.
STILL_TRUE_AND_UNCHANGED.needed_to_close: re-run all 8 variants through the ODE path before any of this is quoted as a generation-quality statement.
